verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships GNOME Boxes as a built-in VM app that handles OS installation for you. That is a first-party VM capability, but the evidence never mentions Windows guests specifically or how well Windows apps run in them. The VirtualBox complaint concerns Fedora running as a guest, not hosting Windows, so it is irrelevant here. Missing for 10: explicit Windows guest support, documentation of Windows VM setup or performance (drivers, integration), and independent hands-on corroboration.
